With stride=128->64, thread 0 reads shared[64] which thread 64 updated (shared[64]+=shared[192]). If positions 192-255 have high loss (~200) and positions 0-191 have near-zero loss, missing even a few updates creates error > tolerance. With 64 high-loss samples per block × 16 blocks = 1024 samples at ~200 loss each, even 1% race-induced error = ~2 in final mean vs tolerance ~0.01+0.01*~50 ≈ 0.5.
